note: Fit of nexys_soc — the board-runnable full 113-op LOGOS SoC (soft_core + UART load/run/readback) — on the Nexys A7-100T (Artix-7 XC7A100T). Reproduce: yosys -p 'read_verilog nexys_soc.v soft_core.v alu.v shared_divider.v; synth_xilinx -family xc7 -flatten -top nexys_soc; stat'. Verified end-to-end in sim by tb_nexys_soc.v (3 programs loaded over UART, run, results read back). The final .bit is a Vivado place-and-route (build_nexys_soc via nexys_soc.xdc); no open 7-series bitstream tool exists.

meta.flow: yosys synth_xilinx -family xc7 -flatten (Vivado for P&R + bitstream)
meta.flatten_note: flattened, so imem/show_mem map to LUTs/FFs not BRAM; Vivado infers block RAM and reduces both counts. These are the conservative (upper-bound) numbers.
